title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences for your account and the app.

personal.title: Personal details
personal.desc: How you appear in the app to your team.
personal.changeLoginHint: To change login methods, use <link>My account</link>.

company.title: Company
company.descOwner: Used in exported reports and documents.
company.descMember: Only the account administrator can edit these details.
company.industryHint: Set on first sign-in — controls which modules appear in the menu.

menuPosition.title: Menu position
menuPosition.desc: Navigation bar at the top or on the left side.

motion.title: Motion
motion.desc: Animates transitions and scroll effects. Reducing makes navigation more direct, independent of your system setting.

a11yWidget.title: Accessibility widget
a11yWidget.desc: Floating button in the bottom-right corner with text size, link underlining, reduced motion and Libras (Brazilian Sign Language). Applies to this device.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Interface language. Follows your account on any device.

chart.title: Default dashboard chart
chart.desc: Initial style of the "Revenue vs. Expenses" chart.

form.title: Found a problem or have an idea?
form.desc: Describe it in as much detail as you can. The team gets it right away and emails you back when it's resolved.
form.localImprovement: Where should it appear or change?
form.localPlaceholder: e.g. Dashboard → Cash flow card; Payables; login screen…
form.atualPlaceholderBug: What did you do and what went wrong? Steps, error message…
form.atualPlaceholderImprovement: How it works today (if it already exists).
form.esperadoPlaceholderImprovement: The idea: what should happen and why.
form.sentBug: Bug sent. Thanks for the report!

mine.title: My submissions
mine.emptyDesc: Your bugs and suggestions show up here with their status and the team's reply.

admin.deniedDesc: This tab is for the NexusFi team only.
